definitionZh: 遮罩大小 CSS 属性指定指定遮罩图像的大小 。 遮罩图像大小可以完全或部分受限,以保持其容积比.
sourceDefinition: The mask-size CSS property specifies the sizes of specified mask images. Mask image sizes can be fully or partially constrained to preserve their aspect ratio.
